name: MATCH (AAPM Grand Challenge)
description: Evaluates markerless lung target tracking methods by comparing participant algorithms on a common dataset and metrics.
evaluation_method: mean localization error (Euclidean distance in mm) and tracking success rate
reputation: Well-regarded within the medical physics / radiotherapy community as an AAPM Grand Challenge for markerless lung target tracking, used by groups working on clinical tracking solutions.
notes: Domain-specific (medical imaging, respiratory motion); performance depends on imaging modality and motion amplitude; limited public data and clinical variability can reduce generalizability; non-LLM benchmark.
